summary: Iteration 4 — Schedule tab + Shifts API. All 10 new backend tests in test_iteration4_shifts.py PASS (admin one_off create+list, recurring parent expanded into ~12 children with parent_shift_id, date-range listing excludes parent, caregiver self-schedule allowed only for assigned client else 403, caregiver cannot schedule for another caregiver, admin can edit all fields, caregiver can edit only notes/service_type, caregiver cannot delete, clock-in→in_progress, clock-out→completed, recurring parent delete cascades to children). Full suite: 46/50 PASS — the 4 failures are the SAME pre-existing iter2 seed-templates test bitrot already documented in iteration_3.json and explicitly called out as unrelated by main agent. Frontend mobile flow verified end-to-end at 390x844: admin login → Schedule tab loads with 'Schedule' header + 'Sunday, June 21 2026' subtitle → Day/Week toggle works (Week shows 7 day groups Mon Jun 15 – Sun Jun 21 with count badges) → nav-prev/today/next works → 'New shift' modal opens with 7 caregiver chips + 1 client chip + service-type chips + date/start/end inputs → filling 2026-06-21 14:00–16:00 Personal Care saves and the shift appears in Day view (status SCHEDULED) → tapping the shift opens edit modal, notes edit persists ('TEST_edited_note' round-tripped), admin sees 'Cancel shift' button which calls DELETE successfully. Caregiver login → Schedule tab loads → 'New shift' modal correctly HIDES the caregiver picker (cg_chips=0) and only shows the 1 assigned client; caregiver sees their existing shift with a 'Clock in' button. Regression: Documents tab still loads after caregiver login. No deprecated Expo packages introduced; no SafeAreaView issues. No React Native red screen errors.

minor.issue: (carry-over, NOT introduced in iter4) accepts arbitrary role in request body — public callers can self-assign admin.

Push notification on creation is only fired for the parent insert, not for each generated child shift. Acceptable — but if children are 'edited' or 'cancelled' later via admin PUT/DELETE, those each emit their own push. Optionally batch the recurring-create push so the caregiver gets ONE 'recurring shift scheduled' notification instead of risking N if logic ever changes.
Caregivers receive q['caregiver_id'] = current.id which silently overrides any caregiver_id query param. Fine for current ACL but consider 403'ing instead so callers can't be misled.

When a caregiver sends disallowed fields (e.g. start_time), they are silently dropped and the endpoint returns 200 with the ORIGINAL values. No 4xx is raised. Consider returning 403 or 400 'fields not allowed for role'.

issues: Date / Start / End / Until are plain TextInputs (YYYY-MM-DD and HH:MM). No native datepicker / time picker — easy to enter invalid dates. Consider react-native-community/datetimepicker or @react-native-community/datetimepicker for mobile. Low priority since iter4 is a manual-only fallback before EVV.

action_items: (Optional, low) Replace YYYY-MM-DD / HH:MM TextInputs in schedule.tsx with native date/time pickers for fewer input mistakes.
(Optional) Have PUT /api/shifts return 403 when a caregiver sends fields outside the allowed set (notes/service_type) rather than silently dropping them.

(Carry-over, not a regression) Reconcile /app/backend/tests/test_iteration2_templates_credentials.py expectations with current seed behavior (4 failures, all pre-existing, documented in iteration_3.json).
critical_code_review_comments: Shift recurring expansion in server.py:_expand_recurring is correct: bounded by 366 days, gracefully no-ops on missing weekdays/until/date, generates children with parent_shift_id and kind='one_off'.
GET /api/shifts correctly excludes recurring parents from date-range queries with $or: [{kind: one_off}, {kind: $exists: false}] — verified in test_recurring_expands_into_children.
Caregiver self-scheduling guard (server.py:585-593) correctly enforces both same-self check AND assignment-exists check; verified 403 in two tests.

schedule.tsx uses Pressable with testID throughout (add-shift-button, view-day, view-week, nav-prev/today/next, pick-cg-{id}, pick-cl-{id}, wd-{MON..}, shift-date/start/end/notes, svc-{type}, save-shift, delete-shift, shift-{id}, clock-in-{id}, clock-out-{id}) — excellent test coverage hooks.
schedule.tsx correctly hides admin-only caregiver picker for caregivers and auto-pins caregiver_id to self via openCreate (line 116). Verified in UI test.
DELETE /api/shifts cascade-deletes children when parent.kind=='recurring' — verified by test_delete_recurring_cascade.
Push notifications via send_push are wrapped in try/except (non-blocking) — good resilience. EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY is read from env, no hardcoding.
server.py is now ~1760 lines — still recommend splitting into routers (documents.py, shifts.py, assignments.py, chat.py) for maintainability (also flagged in iter3).
